title: The Effect of Capital Gains Taxes on Business Creation and Employment: The Case of Opportunity Zones
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. All Opportunity Zone tracts were designated in 2018, so the treatment indicator Designated is time-invariant and the design is Designated x year on biennial tract data (2017 pre, 2019 and 2021 post). The csdid call in Table 7 sets g_csdid = 2019 for every designated tract (one cohort), so Callaway-Sant'Anna collapses to a standard two-group DiD. Most specifications are also pooled OLS or quantile regressions with ACS controls and a lagged growth outcome (emp_growth15) rather than TWFE. Fails the at-least-two-adoption-cohorts rule.
design_notes: Tract-year panel of OZ-eligible Census tracts (dta_tract_allTo2021_DiD.dta), biennial years 2011-2021 (xtset fips year, delta(2)); analysis restricted to years 2017, 2019, 2021. Treatment Designated (Urban Institute list) = 1 for tracts designated as Opportunity Zones in 2018, 0 for eligible-but-undesignated tracts. Main spec (Table 2): reg emp_growth Designated##i.year $cov emp_growth15, variants with qreg, winsorized outcomes, aweight emp15, xtreg fe by fips or cbsa, cluster cbsa. Table 3 splits by metro status. Table 7: csdid ... ivar(fips) time(year) gvar(g_csdid) drimp with g_csdid in {0, 2019}, plus IPW-weighted xtreg event study Designated##ib(2017).year [aw=ps] (Freedman et al. 2023 methodology). Figure 1: IPW-weighted xtreg fe event studies. Table 9: contiguity-ring spillover triple interactions. LODES analysis in 2_3_lodes_analysis.do.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One cohort: OZ designation in 2018 for all treated tracts (g_csdid == 2019 for all Designated == 1).

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date (all tracts designated 2018); pooled OLS without unit FE; later columns add time-varying ACS controls and lagged outcome emp_growth15
specs.outcome: emp_growth (and emp_growth_w005, emp_growth_w010; abi_n_growth variants from line 144)
specs.treatment_definition: Designated = tract designated as an Opportunity Zone in 2018 (Urban Institute list); time-invariant
specs.fe: none in base columns; fips FE (xtreg fe, line 133) or cbsa FE (line 137) in later columns
specs.controls: none in col 1; $cov (12 ACS tract characteristics) + emp_growth15 in later columns

specs.exclusion_reason: single cohort (g_csdid = 2019 for all treated); conditional on time-varying covariates and lagged outcomes
specs.treatment_definition: cohort variable with one treated cohort
specs.fe: csdid (doubly robust, drimp) with covariates $cov emp_growth13 emp_growth15 emp_growth17
specs.sample_condition: Type=="Low-Income Community" & year in {2017, 2019, 2021} & sample==1; also cbsa_status==1 subsample
specs.notes: Reported as a Freedman-Khanna-Neumark style robustness exercise.

data_files_note: Both archives in package_dir (_archive_mnsc.2022.03223.zip, 611 MB; mnsc.2022.03223.zip, 87 MB) lack a central directory: the download stopped partway through the first large data file. Code, README, logs and result tables were recovered by streaming with bsdtar into the scratchpad. Even a complete download would not give the real data: readme.tex states the shipped analysis files are 'exemplary data' with errors deliberately infused into every YTS-derived variable (emp, abi_n, emp_growth, all winsorized growth measures, enter/exit, lagged growth), so results from the package differ from the published tables. Raw YTS/Data Axle establishment data are licensed (WRDS).
software_notes: Stata (reg, qreg, xtreg, csdid, outreg2, estout, regsave, putexcel); Julia for Census API downloads and distance computations; R for contiguity.
